description: Dry run: previews creating or changing up to 10 collections on a client site and returns a plain-text diff (fields added, renamed, removed, items affected). Nothing is saved. Use it whenever the user wants content their client can edit (a menu, inventory, events, team) or a field change; nothing is saved. Show the summary to the user before apply_collection_plan.

collections.description: Collections to create or change, e.g. [{ "name": "Menu", "fields": [{ "label": "Name", "type": "text" }, { "label": "Price", "type": "price", "currency": "USD" }] }].

description.description: Shown to clients in the dashboard, e.g. "Dishes on the dinner menu."

expectedSchemaVersion.description: Required to change an existing collection: the schemaVersion you read with get_collection_schema, e.g. 3.

helpText.description: Hint under the field, e.g. "Leave empty for market price."

key.description: Existing fields: always send their current key (from get_collection_schema), e.g. "price". New fields: omit; it's derived from the label.

max.description: number, price (amount), or text length maximum, e.g. 100.

min.description: number, price (amount), or text length minimum, e.g. 0.

value.description: Stored value, e.g. "vegan"; derived from the label when omitted. Keep existing values unchanged.

required.description: Whether every item needs a value, e.g. true.

slug.description: Matches an existing collection of the site; otherwise a new one gets this slug, e.g. "menu".

templateKey.description: Start a new collection from a template when fields are omitted, e.g. "menu".

titleFieldKey.description: Key of the field shown as each item's title, e.g. "name".

visibility.description: public (default) can be read by the website without a key, e.g. "public".

name: plan_collections
title: Plan collections
